_about: Public-domain Gregory Townsend Bedell (1793-1834), evangelical Episcopal rector of St. Andrew's, Philadelphia, for the Word Hoard: The Life and Travels of St. Paul (1830), The Life of Moses (1832) and his Sermons (2 vols, 1835), from Internet Archive scans. His son Gregory Thurston Bedell has his own shelf. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 55 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

gtbedell-life-of-paul: The life and travels of St. Paul (Philadelphia, American Sunday School Union, 1830)
gtbedell-life-of-moses: The life of Moses (Philadelphia : American Sunday-School Union, 1832)

gtbedell-sermons-2: Sermons, vol. 2 (Philadelphia, W. Stavely-J. C. Pechin, 1835)
